entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, I have some big news...![n]The double cream from that famous[n]crêpe shop is half off right now!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, but I probably can't take a[n]crêpe into the hospital, huh...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I... really want one though...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Do you think maybe Shiho[n]would want one too?
Maybe.
Give it up.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: In that case, I'll buy two!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Though I guess she might have[n]rehab today too. They probably[n]wouldn't even let her eat it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: R-Right...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It might be half off... but I[n]should try to control myself...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shiho might have rehab today too.[n]They probably wouldn't even let her eat it.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh yeah, I forgot to mention—Shiho[n]started her physical rehab. She[n]pushed it up ahead of schedule.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think it's because I told her[n]about how I want to get stronger.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: She said she was gonna[n]start working hard too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I haven't actually seen any of[n]her rehab sessions yet though...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Oh, hold on.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What? Now!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uhhh, that's not good!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry, something just came up![n]That was from my agency.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: One of the models didn't show for[n]a magazine shoot they're doing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: They're looking to wrap soon, so[n]I'm gonna head over now to fill in.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...It's pretty close though.[n]Wanna come with? Actually, let's[n]just go! I'll race you there!
